altsSaved.alt: AI-generated fashion editorial of four adult women smiling together in a warm stone courtyard beside desert dunes. A seated woman in an ivory mini dress clasps hands with a woman leaning forward in a copper embroidered mini. A blonde woman behind her rests an arm around her shoulder, while the fourth woman leans in from the right. Two wear red-and-green crescent-and-star flag dresses. Ivory sandals, rainbow boots, copper platform boots and dark pumps vary across the group.

AI-generated fashion editorial of four adult women sitting at varied heights on cushioned wooden seating beside turquoise tidal channels and pale desert dunes. The woman on the left and the blonde woman beside her smile and clasp hands. Three wear green-and-red crescent-and-star mini dresses; the fourth wears a copper beaded mini. Their footwear includes green pumps, rainbow platforms, a blue star-marked sandal and copper knee-high boots.

AI-generated fashion editorial of four fictional adult women sharing a side hug and reaching toward each other on staggered seats on a wooden terrace. A misty green valley and distant volcanic cone fill the background. They wear two blue-white-red flag-pattern mini outfits, a coral cropped top with a black stitched mini skirt, and a green leaf-embroidered mini dress. Rainbow legwear is paired with ivory pumps, coral knee-high boots, green ankle boots and rainbow platforms. Small RAZE marks and star-themed details decorate some pieces.

AI-generated fashion editorial of four fictional adult women on cushioned benches in a misty forest setting. A blonde woman behind a seated woman gently hugs her shoulders; the seated woman clasps hands with a woman leaning forward in a black-and-green leaf-pattern cropped romper. A fourth woman leans in from the right. Three outfits use blue, white and red flag stripes. Green knee-high boots, violet ankle boots, rainbow platforms and copper strappy heels vary across the group. Several outlined stars decorate the seated woman's upper arm.
